messages.subject: Extra Jenkins messages
parts:
If there are extra messages flying around, that's me -- I've been trying to refactor out CmdStan and I think I got it working. I've created new Jenkins jobs that will test everything by merging changes on the Stan branch into CmdStan to test.

Of the pull requests, I think we should address:
- #588 pulling CmdStan into its own repository (all testing on Jenkins will change once that's in place)
- #587 C++-11 parser fixes. This shouldn't conflict with #588 and Ben's ok'ed it, so it should be good to go once the changes are in.
- #585 LBFGS -- I'll review it in the next few days. I'm guessing it'll conflict with #588. I can try to fix the incompatibilities.
- #582 appendix.tex -- should be easy to verify, but should still wait until #588 gets in.
- everything else.

Bob just reviewed #588, so once that's in, we should have our tests back in place and we can make "fast" progress again.



Daniel
